Hi Laura / Neha (cc Markus),

We have an offer out to Lina Kovács for Senior Data Engineer (start target: Sep 1). She is based in Hungary today and would require Redwood to sponsor an EU Blue Card / work permit and provide a relocation package. I’m putting together the numbers for approvals — please see the quotes attached (immigration counsel and relocation vendor) and the draft offer packet.

Summary of requested support (estimates):
- Immigration counsel retainer and filing (Anderson Law): €6,500 (retainer + filings)
- Work-permit filing fees / admin: €1,200
- Relocation stipend (lump-sum): €8,000
- Temporary housing support (4 weeks): €3,200
- One-way flight + family ticket estimate: €1,200
- Household goods shipping (partial): €900
- Total: ~€20,000 (one-time)

Rationale: Lina hit a strong bench of interviewers (attached scorecard). The role is critical to Q4 roadmap (real-time feature infra), and she has domain expertise that will materially shorten ramp. Candidate has asked for the combination of sponsorship + some upfront liquidity for move costs; she will sign contingent on reasonable immigration support and a relocation allowance.

Ask: Can we approve up to €20k in one-time hiring-related expenses and the immigration retainer so we can finalize the offer? If full approval isn’t possible, please advise on preferred caps (e.g., cap relocation stipend at €6k or cover only the immigration counsel + filing fees).

If approved, I’ll: 1) update the offer to reflect the approved package; 2) instruct Anderson Law to begin intake; 3) confirm MoveIt booking windows.

Thanks — Karthik

- For the relocation package: finance can approve up to EUR 12,000 total one-time for this hire, conditional on the following:

  * Temporary housing will be reimbursed up to EUR 2,400 (requires receipts)
  * Travel and shipping up to EUR 1,600 combined (requires receipts)

Please confirm that the candidate is comfortable with the cap and that the offer includes a 6-month clawback as Laura recommended. Also, confirm tax treatment (Neha). Once those items are confirmed I’ll route PO and payment instructions.

-Markus
